'''Third Grade Assistant Technician''' was a job on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Kharl Vanneb]] and [[Sakme Kelene]], both graduates of the [[Theed School of Technology and Engineering]], were hired as Third Grade Assistant Technicians at the satellite's moon base.<ref name="PITI">{{GamerCite|1|Peril in the Ionosphere}}</ref>
